summary: Lists the requirements for a protocol that sets up the security keys for encrypted SIP media streams (SRTP). Beyond basic security needs, such a protocol must work smoothly with SIP. It also summarizes and compares the proposals that existed at the time.

eli5.summary: Two people on a call need to agree on a secret code before they can scramble their voices. This note lists what a good way of agreeing on that code must do, and reviews the ideas people had proposed.

questions: what are the requirements for srtp key exchange
how to negotiate keys for secure sip media
